what_you_can_do: Gift refurbished devices; give rejects to recyclers; no sales.
legal_certainty: High: no buying or selling, so s 7 is not engaged.
conditions: Keep records anyway; never take payment or 'donations' in exchange for a device.

what_you_can_do: Paid repairs of customer-owned devices; donate surplus.
conditions: Don't buy devices or take trade-ins.

model: Partner charity sells under its fundraising authority
what_you_can_do: Charity sells refurbished devices you donate to it; you volunteer with written authority.
limits: You can't sell in your own name; proceeds belong to the charity's appeal.
legal_certainty: Medium: depends on the charity's authority and Fair Trading's reading of s 4(2)(a).
conditions: Written participant authority; charity controls sales and proceeds.

model: Genuine recycling program selling collected goods (cl 33)
what_you_can_do: Collect free through a public program; refurbish; sell collected goods; recycle the rest.
limits: No buying stock from the public; scope of 'program' unconfirmed.
legal_certainty: Low to medium until Fair Trading answers in writing.
conditions: Only after a written Fair Trading view; keep purchased stock out entirely.

model: Section 4A exemption from s 7 or specific duties (discretionary)
limits: No whole-licence precedent; conditions; published; revocable.
legal_certainty: Low until Fair Trading indicates it would consider one.

what_you_can_do: Buy, sell and consign any electronic goods.
limits: ID checks, police reporting within 3 days, 14-day hold with no alteration, records, notified premises.
conditions: Can't trade while the application is pending.
